name_zh: 亚美尼亚·种族灭绝幸存记录者：记忆与流散
name_en: Armenia Genocide Survivor Chronicler: Memory & Diaspora
description_zh: 1915年亚美尼亚种族灭绝幸存者与记录者群体，通过回忆录、口述史、档案整理保存历史记忆，在流散中重建亚美尼亚民族认同，推动国际承认与正义。
description_en: 1915 Armenian Genocide survivors and chroniclers, preserved historical memory through memoirs, oral history, archival work, rebuilt Armenian national identity in diaspora, pushed for international recognition and justice.
reason_zh: 种族灭绝幸存记录者展示了创伤记忆如何转化为民族重建的精神资源，体现流散群体通过记忆传承维持民族连续性的核心机制。
reason_en: Genocide survivor chroniclers demonstrate how traumatic memory transforms into spiritual resource for national reconstruction, embodying core mechanism of diaspora groups maintaining ethnic continuity through memory transmission.
steps_zh: 研究1915种族灭绝历史背景与奥斯曼帝国政策
分析幸存者回忆录与口述史收集整理过程
探讨流散社区在中东欧美建立记忆机构
评估国际承认运动与土耳其否认的博弈
总结记忆传承对当代亚美尼亚民族认同的塑造
steps_en: Study 1915 genocide historical context and Ottoman Empire policies
Analyze survivor memoirs and oral history collection process
Explore diaspora communities establishing memory institutions in Middle East Europe US
Evaluate international recognition movement and Turkish denial game
Summarize memory transmission shaping contemporary Armenian national identity
expected_zh: 理解种族灭绝记忆如何成为民族重建核心资源，掌握流散群体记忆传承机制，评估其对国际人权法与种族灭绝预防的贡献。
expected_en: Understand how genocide memory becomes core resource for national reconstruction, grasp diaspora memory transmission mechanism, evaluate its contribution to international human rights law and genocide prevention.
case_zh: 1915 150万亚美尼亚人遇害；幸存者建立亚美尼亚革命联盟流亡政府；1965年叶里万建立种族灭绝纪念碑；2015年百年纪念全球承认。记忆传承重建民族认同永存。
case_en: 1915 1.5M Armenians killed; survivors established ARF exile government; 1965 Yerevan genocide memorial built; 2015 centennial global recognition. Memory transmission rebuilding national identity endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Genocide memory paradigm; diaspora identity reconstruction; international recognition movement
